svg.text: Arduino Uno + PCA9685 + 8 servos · separate 6 V / 10 A servo supply · common ground
e.g. 6 V 10 A adapter / LRS-75-5 set to 6 V
V+ terminal stays empty (servo power comes from the bus)
Never power servos from the Arduino 5 V pin. All grounds must be joined. Set each servo to 90° before attaching the tendon.
